description: This file defines the ConceptAnswer class, representing an answer option for a Concept question in the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes fields for concept associations, answer details, creator info, timestamps, and sort order, along with relevant constructors and methods.

classes.name: ConceptAnswer
classes.description: Represents an answer to a Concept question, linking the question concept with the answer concept or drug, and capturing metadata such as creator and creation date.

methods.name: getAnswerConcept
methods.description: Returns the Concept object representing the answer.

methods.name: getAnswerDrug
methods.description: Returns the Drug object if the answer is a drug.

methods.name: setAnswerDrug
methods.description: Sets the answer as a Drug.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Returns the question Concept this answer is associated with.

methods.name: getConceptAnswerId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this ConceptAnswer.

methods.name: setConceptAnswerId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this ConceptAnswer.

methods.name: getCreator
methods.description: Gets the User who created this answer.

methods.name: setCreator
methods.description: Sets the User who created this answer.

methods.name: getDateCreated
methods.description: Returns the creation date of this answer.

methods.name: getSortWeight
methods.description: Returns the sort weight used for ordering answers.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this answer to another based on sort weight.
